subject: Renewal + Expansion: pricing step-ups & blended rates for Acme Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jesse Turner <jesse.turner@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 15:23:00 +0000
Subject: Post-call recap + asks - renewal & expansion pricing

Hi Jesse - thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment going into procurement/legal: 

Recap
- Current contract up for renewal Feb 1, 2027.
- Customer intent: expand usage across two new routes (summarization and rerank) in addition to chat + embeddings.
- Primary goals: predictable unit economics, lower blended $/1M tokens as volume grows, and minimize risk during migration.

Action items / asks from your side (so we can model pricing):
1) Current average monthly token consumption (historical 3mo and 12mo if available).
2) Expected step-up timeline and target monthly tokens after expansion (month-by-month if possible).
3) Any target $/1M tokens or budget range procurement is trying to hit (example: $10-$14 / 1M).
4) Mix by route expected (chat vs embeddings vs summarization vs rerank) - approximate percentages.
5) Procurement timeline and decision owner + expected PO/contract cadence.

What we'll do on our side
- Build a blended-rate pricing proposal that shows (a) reserved step-ups for committed volumes, (b) blended example rates across routes, and (c) an option for Dedicated reserved capacity with deeper discounts.
- Include unit economics with examples ($/1M token at different thresholds) and an estimated monthly spend curve.

I'm attaching a small template you can use to paste projected tokens (monthly) - if you can return that, I’ll run the blended scenarios and send a draft pricing doc for procurement/legal review.

Proposed next meeting: 30-min slot the week of Dec 13 to review the draft and align on procurement timeline.

Thanks - Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Jesse Turner <jesse.turner@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Acme Health Procurement <procure@acmehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + asks - renewal & expansion pricing

Thanks Marissa - good summary. Answers below and I attached our simple projection file.

1) Current avg monthly tokens (last 3mo): ~75M tokens / month (chat heavy). 12mo avg: ~48M/mo.
2) Expansion plan: we expect a step-up to ~150M tokens/mo within 6-9 months post-renewal as we roll out summarization + rerank to two additional products. Timeline: Jan-Mar 2027 (pilot), Apr-Jun full rollout (gradual ramp).
3) Procurement target budget: roughly $10-$14 per 1M tokens blended, but need to show finance how different scenarios hit our $/month budget.
4) Mix by route after expansion (est): chat 55%, embeddings 25%, summarization 15%, rerank 5% (these shift during ramp).
5) Procurement: procurement lead is Sandra Li (procure@acmehealth.com). Target to have terms + PO in Jan 2027.

Notes:
- Security: SOC 2 evidence will be needed - happy to include Redwood SOC artifacts once we have procurement outline.
- We'd prefer blended pricing (single $/1M across routes) for simplicity, but we understand different model routes have different costs - show us blended vs route-specific.

Attaching: acme_volume_projection_dec2026.csv

Appreciate the draft pricing - let’s aim to sync next week.

Best,
Jesse
Jesse Turner
Head of Product - AI | Acme Health
jesse.turner@acmehealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jesse Turner <jesse.turner@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Dec 2026 16:47:00 +0000
Subject: Draft pricing - step-ups, blended rates & routes (attached)

Jesse - thanks for the projection file, that’s very helpful. Draft attached (summary below). We focused on two paths: Reserved step-ups (committed volumes with stepped discounts) and Blended-tier (single blended $/1M across routes based on mix).

Proposal highlights (draft):
- Baseline (month 0-3): 75M tokens/mo baseline pricing at $16.00 / 1M tokens
- Step-up thresholds (monthly committed volume):
  - 0-9M: $16.00 / 1M
  - 100-199M: $12.00 / 1M
  - 200M+: $9.00 / 1M
- Example blended scenarios (using your post-expansion mix, 150M tokens/mo):
  - Blended effective rate = (55% chat @ $12 est + 25% embeddings @ $8 est + 15% summarization @ $10 est + 5% rerank @ $14 est) -> ~ $11.7 / 1M tokens
- Dedicated reserved capacity option: 12-mo commitment for a 20-30% unit discount vs hosted, plus predictable throughput and prefix/KV cache benefits.
- Add-on: SOC 2 evidence pack and extended retention for audit logs (priced separately).

Notes and asks:
- These are draft numbers - if procurement is pushing for $10-$14 / 1M blended, the 100M threshold ($12 /1M) is likely the right negotiation point.
- If you can confirm the expected % mix during months 3-6 post-rollout, I’ll re-run the blended math and provide a finalized offer with a short SOW and DocuSign-ready contract.

Next steps
1) Confirm mix assumptions (3-6mo post-rollout).
2) Confirm whether Acme prefers a single blended line item on the invoice or split by route.
3) We’ll schedule a 30-min call with procurement/legal and solutions engineering to review the draft and alignment on SOC 2 artifacts.

Attaching: 20261212-acme_pricing_draft.pdf

Available times Wed Dec 15 between 10-12 PT - propose a 30-min with Sandra and your procurement team.

Thanks - Marissa
Marissa Cole

marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Also: I’ll confirm the 3-6mo mix by end of day tomorrow and flag any hard caps procurement needs. Looking forward to the call.

Best,
Jesse
